Household Pulse Survey (HPS)

Household Pulse Survey (HPS)

The Census Bureau's online survey of US adults on how the COVID-19 pandemic and later events affected households, every one or two weeks from April 2020 (weeks 1-63, 2020-2023) and in two-week cycles in 2024 (cycles 1-9). The questionnaire was revised by phase (1, 2, 3, 3.1-3.10, 4.0-4.2). Each week or cycle is its own public use file, and its own release here.

Publisher
U.S. Census Bureau
Dataset
https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/household-pulse-survey.html
Terms
https://www.census.gov/about/policies/open-gov.html
The Census Bureau's Open Government page: "The U.S. Census Bureau publishes its data as open data, meaning it is freely available for use and re-use by the public." The PUFs and their documentation are works of a US federal agency. The Census Data API's terms of service (https://www.census.gov/data/developers/about/terms-of-service.html) ask API products to say they are "not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau"; this repo doesn't use the API.
wave
week (2020-2023) or cycle (2024) — Each week or cycle is one release, so a release holds one wave, named like the release (week01-week63, cycle01-cycle09).
